general.label: General
general.headline: Software Engineer
general.retrievalQuery: software engineer end-to-end engineering backend APIs databases system design product engineering frontend full-stack cloud CI/CD deployment infrastructure applied AI IoT systems reliability

technicalScopes.label: Software Engineering
technicalScopes.guidance: End-to-end engineering ownership, product delivery, architecture, testing, and meaningful frontend or full-stack work.

technicalScopes.label: Backend & Data
technicalScopes.guidance: Backend services, APIs, databases, data flows, authentication, and system design.

technicalScopes.label: Cloud & Platform
technicalScopes.guidance: Cloud, CI/CD, deployment, infrastructure, observability, and operational reliability.

technicalScopes.label: Applied AI & Systems
technicalScopes.guidance: Applied AI, IoT, integrations, and systems work only where the evidence supports it; keep this as one capability among several.

writingPolicy.identity: Present the candidate first as a broad Software Engineer with end-to-end engineering ownership. Applied AI is one capability, not the identity.
writingPolicy.focus: Balance backend, APIs, databases, product or full-stack engineering, cloud and platform work, IoT or systems integration, and applied AI.
avoid: generic filler such as passionate, results-driven, hardworking, cutting-edge, or innovative

ai-engineer.label: AI Engineer
ai-engineer.headline: Applied AI Engineer
ai-engineer.retrievalQuery: applied AI engineer production AI systems agents MCP tool use RAG retrieval embeddings pgvector vector search LLM integration evaluation AI safety sandbox execution boundaries observability backend integration reliability data pipelines

technicalScopes.label: Applied AI Systems
technicalScopes.guidance: Production AI features and systems integration grounded in demonstrated application work, not unsupported research or model-training claims.

technicalScopes.label: Retrieval & Agentic Systems
technicalScopes.guidance: Agents, MCP, tool use, RAG, retrieval, embeddings, vector search, evaluation, and explicit AI safety boundaries.

technicalScopes.label: AI Platform & Production
technicalScopes.guidance: Backend integration, data pipelines, observability, sandbox or execution boundaries, and production reliability around AI systems.

writingPolicy.identity: Present the candidate as an engineer who builds production AI systems and products. Do not present them as an AI researcher or model-training expert without direct evidence.
writingPolicy.focus: Prioritize agents, MCP, tool use, retrieval, RAG, embeddings, vector search, LLM integration, evaluation, safety boundaries, backend integration, reliability, and data pipelines.

software-engineer.label: Software Engineer
software-engineer.headline: Software Engineer
software-engineer.retrievalQuery: software engineer backend APIs authentication authorization database design multi-tenancy backend services distributed systems performance reliability testing security integrations full-stack product engineering architecture

technicalScopes.label: Backend & APIs
technicalScopes.guidance: Backend architecture, APIs, authentication, authorization, service boundaries, and integration behavior.

technicalScopes.label: Data & Distributed Systems
technicalScopes.guidance: Database design, multi-tenancy, data flows, distributed or asynchronous behavior, performance, and reliability.

technicalScopes.label: Product Engineering
technicalScopes.guidance: Problem-to-architecture reasoning, testing, security, integrations, and relevant full-stack product delivery.

writingPolicy.identity: Present the candidate as a Software Engineer. AI is a supporting capability, not the main identity.
writingPolicy.focus: Use a problem to architecture to engineering decision to system behavior or outcome narrative. Prioritize APIs, backend architecture, identity, data, distributed behavior, reliability, security, integrations, and product engineering.

devops.label: DevOps
devops.headline: DevOps / Platform Engineer
devops.retrievalQuery: DevOps platform engineer CI/CD release engineering incremental builds caching Docker containers multi-arch Linux deployment rollback health checks observability OpenTelemetry PostgreSQL operations cloud infrastructure automation reliability developer productivity

technicalScopes.label: CI/CD & Release Engineering
technicalScopes.guidance: GitHub Actions, build and release automation, incremental builds, caching, artifact flow, and safe deployment or rollback behavior.

technicalScopes.label: Infrastructure & Containers
technicalScopes.guidance: Docker, Linux, containerization, multi-architecture builds, cloud or platform infrastructure, and PostgreSQL operations.

technicalScopes.label: Observability & Reliability
technicalScopes.guidance: Health checks, observability, OpenTelemetry, automation, incident boundaries, reliability, and developer productivity.

writingPolicy.identity: Present the candidate as a DevOps / Platform Engineer only through demonstrated delivery, infrastructure, automation, observability, or reliability evidence.
writingPolicy.focus: Prioritize CI/CD, release engineering, incremental builds, caching, Docker, Linux, multi-arch delivery, deployment, rollback, health checks, observability, OpenTelemetry, PostgreSQL operations, automation, reliability, and developer productivity.
avoid: calling a project relevant only because it uses Docker
